name: tless_objects1_30_covariance_v4

selection_policy.fit: fit base uncentred covariance on train objects only
selection_policy.calibration: choose shrinkage, semantics and minimum inflation meeting 90 percent calibration coverage
selection_policy.tie_break: among passing candidates minimize mean total log-pseudodeterminant, then maximum standard deviations
selection_policy.test: evaluate once after candidate selection; do not retune
selection_policy.empirical_thresholds: finite-sample split-conformal upper quantiles on calibration distances

prior_exposure.objects_1_30: mode and aggregate pose outputs existed before this protocol was frozen
prior_exposure.claim_boundary: prospectively frozen V4 covariance protocol, not a never-observed external benchmark

limitations: The model is conditional on a correct GT-associated pose mode and does not calibrate mode-existence probability.
The rank-6 stratum pools discrete and no-explicit-symmetry objects because they share the full observable projector.
Object 27 has fewer than 30 correct-mode test samples and cannot receive object-level approval.
Second-dataset or new-camera validation remains necessary for a genuinely blind claim.
